title: Astrid Nørgaard Friis (Grundfos Group VP Corporate Affairs) picks Incorruptible for her summer reading
summary: Astrid Nørgaard Friis — Group Vice President of Corporate Affairs at Grundfos, the Danish foundation-owned pump maker profiled as a case study IN Incorruptible — publicly names the book on her summer reading list. The company's own executive validating the case study from the inside.
blockquote: Incorruptible by Eric Ries, I believe in strong ethics and good corporate governance, and I want to hear his take.
attribution_title: Group Vice President, Corporate Affairs, Grundfos
